novelty_search.nearest_results: The valid native-order block-8 component cube found attention8 materially causal at the will/had subject-onset bank: omitting it loses 0.1985 recovery in A1 and 0.1236 in A2, although carried entry state has the largest Shapley value. Existing L9H1/H4 results identify downstream readers, not the block-8 writer heads.
novelty_search.new_question: Is the material block-8 attention update into the subject-onset bank concentrated in one reusable head or distributed across heads?

population: All 64 sealed A1/A2 will/had rows in two fixed 32-row construction batches.

interventions.destinations: Only the determiner and head-noun positions immediately after the temporal cue.
interventions.singleton_heads: For each of block 8's 12 heads, replace that head's pre-c_proj output at both destinations by its paired donor value during an otherwise native base forward.
interventions.full_heads: Replace all 12 pre-c_proj head outputs at the destinations.
interventions.direct_output_closure: Replace the complete post-c_proj attention output at the same destinations by the paired donor output; it must match the full-head arm within 1e-4 selected-logit error.
interventions.fitting: none; no head is selected or tuned during the run

opposing_predictions.concentrated_writer: At least one fixed head independently retains at least half of the full-head mean recovery, with donorward fraction at least 0.75, in both A1 and A2.
opposing_predictions.distributed_writer: No single head reaches that bar in both constructions even though the complete attention update is materially positive.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_head_i: All authorities and capability hold; manual replay is within 1e-4; full-head/direct-output selected-logit closure is within 1e-4; every arm-row is finite and present.
predictions.pred_b_material_attention_branch_recurre: The full-head arm has mean recovery at least 0.10 in A1 and 0.06 in A2, with donorward fraction at least 0.75 in both.
predictions.pred_c_shared_single_head_concentration: At least one identical head has singleton mean recovery at least 0.50 of the full-head recovery and donorward fraction at least 0.75 in both A1 and A2.
predictions.pred_d_complete_head_ranking_reported: Report all 12 singleton effects and the shared-head intersection without adaptive subset search; this descriptive ranking cannot rescue C.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 32 model forwards, 1024 example evaluations, 896 arm-row records, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass. Promote the shared singleton head and next partition its exact source tokens.
terminal.null: A, B, and E pass but no shared singleton head passes C; retain the complete ranking and classify the writer as distributed at singleton resolution.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, replay, full-head/direct closure, material-branch recurrence, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

scope: This localizes block-8 attention writer heads at the established destinations. It does not test upstream source tokens, carried-state provenance, or low-rank compression.
